dialogues.speaker: Fouad
dialogues.text: Ah, I see I guessed correctly.

dialogues.speaker: Fouad
dialogues.text: The boss told us what you look like. He said you're our new buddy.

dialogues.speaker: Fouad
dialogues.text: You have pretty distinct traits, so I recognized you right away.

dialogues.speaker: Fouad
dialogues.text: Well, since the boss says so, guess that makes you a friend of ours now. The Eremites bid you welcome.
